407:t_2:18.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I'm giving you this key. Use it when the fleet is in danger.」

407:t_2:20.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Look after... the fleet...」

407:t_2:21.en:
$$リジット$$
「Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$! $$ガルガンティア$$ needs you!」

407:t_2:22.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「$$リジット$$... You are... the new Fleet Commander...」

407:t_2:24.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...You've grown... so fine... I can... report it... proudly... to your... late father...」

407:t_2:31.en:
$$レド$$
「So this is Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s unit...」

407:t_2:32.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「Welcome, we have been expecting you. Emissary from the heavens, clad in the giant of thunder. In the name of Providence, may prosperity and peace be upon you.」

407:t_2:33.en:
$$レド$$
[$$チェインバー#pilot$$... What is this woman saying?]

407:t_2:34.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is likely an idiom referring to a machine caliber and its pilot.]

407:t_2:35.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「I am $$オンデリア$$. I serve as the shrine maiden of this fleet.」

407:t_2:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is a term for a woman who serves a god.]

407:t_2:38.en:
$$レド$$
「Where is Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$?」

407:t_2:39.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「...It seems preparations are nearly ready.」

407:t_2:40.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Forgive me for appearing by video.」

407:t_2:41.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$...! I'm glad you're safe...」

407:t_2:42.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Not exactly safe. I came down with an endemic disease...」

407:t_2:43.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I can't leave this sterilized cockpit. Are you all right?」

407:t_2:45.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I see... Giving orders from here is more of a hassle than you'd think.」

407:t_2:47.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Having you around is a help. So, will you follow me again?」

407:t_2:49.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「What's wrong? Do you have lingering regrets about that local unit?」

407:t_2:50.en:
$$レド$$
「...No. I will join your command, Lieutenant Colonel.」

407:t_2:51.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I see... Now I can get started on our mission.」

407:t_2:53.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The people of this planet have such a blessed environment, yet they are overwhelmed and terrified by the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$.」

407:t_2:54.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Our mission is to teach them how to fight, and to enlighten them about the dignity of humankind.」

407:t_2:55.en:
$$レド$$
「...About that, Lieutenant Colonel. The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... they are human, sir.」

407:t_2:58.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「It seems to have been an unspoken understanding among the upper brass. But it's information we frontline soldiers don't need.」

407:t_2:60.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ just live by their desires and breed. I can't call that human.」

407:t_2:62.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The strong and the weak support each other through reason. Each contributes in their own way, and together they build a society. ...That is what makes a human, isn't it?」

407:t_2:64.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I gave this fleet order. As a result, under the present ruling system, the happiness of the fleet's members has risen significantly.」

407:t_2:65.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Request a definition of happiness in this context.」

407:t_2:67.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Under the ideals of the $$銀河同盟$$, happiness is defined as the state in which the cost-effectiveness of an individual's service to the whole reaches maximum efficiency.」

407:t_2:68.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Therefore, happiness is proportional to the stability of leadership.」

407:t_2:69.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I concur with the definition and the conclusion.」

407:t_2:71.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Say, $$レド$$... Why don't you and I change this planet together?」

407:t_2:73.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The fleet you belonged to has already merged with mine.」

407:t_2:74.en:
$$レド$$
(He means $$ピニオン$$ and the others' ship...)

407:t_2:75.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「I'll get right to it: I need your strength.」

407:t_2:76.en:
$$レド$$
「Against the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, sir?」

407:t_2:77.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「No... I mean the enlightenment campaign for this planet's inhabitants.」

407:t_2:78.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「That way we change people's minds, and in time unify the will of this planet's humanity and reborn it as a solid social group.」

407:t_2:80.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Good answer. With you here, we can carry out the enlightenment operation I've been planning for some time.」

407:t_2:81.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The target is a fleet called $$ガルガンティア$$.」

407:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You needn't say a word, I already know. This is about $$ブレラ$$.」

407:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z, born of the strong heart you had when you fought $$ブレラ$$... I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

407:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, you surprised me. Normally, you and $$ブレラ$$ weren't that close.」

407:t_10:9.en:
$$オズマ$$
「He's $$ランカ$$'s brother... Which makes him my brother too.」

407:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... Then, with $$アルト$$, that makes three sworn brothers.」

407:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh? I thought you'd get angry: 'I won't let that guy anywhere near $$ランカ$$!' ...」

407:t_10:13.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's for $$ランカ$$ and $$アルト$$ to decide. It's not my place to step in anymore.」

407:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Admirable, $$オズマ$$. Today's drink is on me.」

407:t_10:15.en:
$$オズマ$$
($$ランカ$$, that's how it is. Live for yourself, with no regrets.)

407:t_10:16.en:
$$オズマ$$
(We'll handle $$ブレラ$$ somehow. Rest easy and wait...)

uncertain: t_2:29 caption: $$クーゲル$$ Fleet (no token for クーゲル船団)
t_2:33-37: マシンキャリバー = 'machine caliber'; 巫女 = 'shrine maiden'
